run_refine_3dg_dataset: run the refine_3dg_dataset script to optimize volumetric primitives given reference images and camera parameters
create_batch_sensor: create a batch sensor from multiple camera specifications for multi-view rendering in Mitsuba
build_optimization_pipeline: build an optimization pipeline using BoundedAdam to refine 3D Gaussian ellipsoid primitives against reference images
test_render_quality: test rendering quality by computing PSNR and L1 loss between rendered and reference images
save_optimized_asset: save the optimized volumetric primitive scene as an asset with loss and PSNR plots
